about_the_game:
Dive into a 5v5 strategic experience that celebrates the spirit of the MOBA genre’s early days—Inspired by classic League of Legends.

Face off against your rivals on a sprawling three-lane battlefield where coordination and skill make all the difference. This homage to the 2010 era is crafted for those who seek the purest form of tactical competition, free from distractions.

Key Features:

  • Three-Lane Battlefield & Neutral Jungle: Explore interconnected lanes and wild zones for ambushes and strategic maneuvers.

  • Archetypal Heroes: Over 40 original combatants—from long-range archers to melee warriors and elemental mages—each with their primordial skill sets.

  • Customizable Runes & Perks System: Define your playstyle with a static runes tree and perks that amplify key attributes and mechanics.

  • Classic Gold Economy: Generate passive gold and earn bonuses for kills and creature waves, following the genre’s foundational rules.

  • 5v5 Only on the Main Map: No side modes—100% focus on the ultimate strategic showdown.

  • Authentic Retro Aesthetic: Minimalist UI, original visual effects, and animations that evoke the early MOBA scene.

  • Custom Rooms & Active Community: Host private matches, forge alliances, and relive the camaraderie of the golden era.

  • Pure Skill Focus: No battle passes or forced progressions—only your dexterity and teamwork lead to victory.

  • Rank System: Back the old Rank system

Rediscover the thrill of those first online battles and prove that sometimes, classic is the deadliest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel o AMD de doble núcleo a 2,8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 9600GT or AMD Radeon HD 6570, or Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel o AMD de doble núcleo a 3,0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600/9600GT, ATI/AMD Radeon HD2600/3600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
